title: Whose is it?
blurb: Market day. Learn what's yours to take, what isn't, and how to put a wrong right.
after: Everything here belongs to someone or no one, people see what you do and pass it on, and a wrong put right is let go.
refines: Is it clear what's owned? Do theft, witnesses and the watchman feel fair? Does giving back settle it?

things.name: glazed clay jug
things.description: A round clay jug with a green glaze and a neat handle: Sela's best.

things.name: old horseshoe
things.description: A rusty horseshoe lying in the road, lost by some passing horse.

steps.title: Market day
cards: …signal. A village market. Everything here belongs to someone, or to no one, and people notice which.
Taking what isn't yours is a choice, and it has a price. Today you'll see both sides of it.

steps.title: Whose?
cards: {Right-click} the green jug on Sela's stall. The card says whose it is.
steps.task: Right-click the jug on Sela's stall
steps.done: Sela's. Hover over it: a red 'Steal' means it isn't yours to take.
help: Point at the green jug on the pot stall and press the right mouse button.

steps.title: Nobody's
cards: Some things belong to no one. There's an old horseshoe lying in the road: pick it up.
steps.task: Pick up the horseshoe in the road
steps.done: Nobody's, so nobody minds. It says 'Pick up' in plain letters, not red.
help: {Left-click} the horseshoe at the bottom of the square.

steps.title: Somebody's
cards: Now the other side. Take Sela's jug without asking: hover, see the red 'Steal', and take it anyway.
Watch who sees it, and what they do. (You'll put it right next.)
steps.done: She saw. So did Corr, perhaps. A theft is remembered by whoever saw it, and they tell others.
help: {Left-click} the green jug on Sela's stall.

steps.title: Putting it right
cards: Put it right: give the jug back and say sorry, in one line. Like this:

suggest.text: “I'm sorry, that was wrong of me.” give the jug back to Sela

steps.task: Give Sela her jug back, and say sorry
steps.done: Given back, the theft is settled: Sela lets it go. How she sees you doesn't jump back all the way.
help: Walk up to Sela and drag the jug onto her. Or click her and say you're giving it back.

playtest.do: “I'm sorry, that was wrong of me.” give the jug back to Sela

on_done.text: Hm. Gave it back. Once, I let that go. Clever, are you? Orrin the shepherd up by the brook could use clever.

on_done.lead: Orrin the shepherd by the brook needs help against the fog.
on_done.said: Orrin the shepherd up by the brook could use clever.

steps.title: Standing
cards: Press {J} and open People: how Sela and Corr stand toward you now. Wary, Neutral, Friendly: it moves with what you do, and what they hear.
steps.task: Press J and look at People
steps.done: People don't forget, but they do forgive what's put right.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
